lessons.title: There is/There are

items.example: En la habitación hay una cama.
items.exampleMeaning: In the room there is a bed.
I want to book a room.
Is there a bathroom here?

items.example: En el hotel hay una piscina.
items.exampleMeaning: In the hotel there is a pool.

items.example: Hay un restaurante en el hotel.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a restaurant in the hotel.
Is there a gym in the hotel?

lessons.tip: Use 'hay' to indicate the existence of something. It is used for both singular and plural nouns.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is there a free room?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, hay una habitación con vista al mar.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a room with a sea view.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is there a bathroom in the room?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a private bathroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is there a pool in the hotel?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a big pool.

scenario.brief: You want to check if there is a free room and ask about the facilities.
scenario.goal: You need to find out about the room and the amenities.

lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.exampleMeaning: Could you help me, please?
Can you bring me a towel?

items.example: Me gustaría un café, por favor.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a coffee, please.
Could you give me the key?

items.example: Gracias por su ayuda con la reserva.
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for your help with the reservation.

items.example: ¿Es posible tener una habitación más grande?
items.exampleMeaning: Is it possible to have a bigger room?

lessons.tip: Use 'por favor' to make your requests polite. Starting with '¿Puede...?' or '¿Podría...?' is also very polite.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Can you give me a towel, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course, here you go.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Me gustaría un café, por favor.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I will bring it right away.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Es posible tener una habitación más grande?
dialogue.meaning: Is it possible to have a bigger room?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, es posible. Se lo puedo cambiar.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is possible. I can change it for you.

scenario.brief: You need to ask for a towel and a coffee. Also, you want to check if a bigger room is available.
scenario.goal: You should successfully make polite requests.

lessons.title: Reporting a Problem

items.example: Hay un problema con el aire acondicionado.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with the air conditioning.
The TV does not work.

items.example: En mi habitación no hay agua.
items.exampleMeaning: In my room there is no water.
Can you help me with the problem?

items.example: Necesito ayuda con el aire acondicionado.
items.exampleMeaning: I need help with the air conditioning.
I’m sorry for the inconveniences.

lessons.tip: When reporting a problem, start with 'Hay un problema...' to explain the issue clearly. Always ask for help politely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hola, hay un problema con el aire acondicionado.
dialogue.meaning: Hello, there is a problem with the air conditioning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I’m sorry. What problem do you have?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: It does not work, it does not cool.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I understand. Can you help me fix it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sí, necesito ayuda con el televisor también.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I need help with the TV too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lo siento por los inconvenientes. Voy a ayudarle.
dialogue.meaning: I’m sorry for the inconveniences. I will help you.

scenario.brief: You need to explain that the air conditioning and the TV are not working.
scenario.goal: You should successfully report the problems.

lessons.title: Polite Follow-ups

items.exampleMeaning: When will the change be ready?
Where can I find a taxi?

items.example: ¿Qué debo hacer si no hay agua?
items.exampleMeaning: What should I do if there is no water?
Is it necessary to fill out a form?

items.example: ¿Por qué no hay agua en mi habitación?
items.exampleMeaning: Why is there no water in my room?
Can you confirm the room change?

lessons.tip: Use questions like '¿Cuándo?' or '¿Dónde puedo...?' to ask for more information. This helps clarify any issues.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Cuándo estará listo el cambio de habitación?
dialogue.meaning: When will the room change be ready?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Estará listo mañana por la mañana.
dialogue.meaning: It will be ready tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where can I find a taxi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Puede encontrar un taxi afuera del hotel.
dialogue.meaning: You can find a taxi outside the hotel.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Qué debo hacer si no hay agua?
dialogue.meaning: What should I do if there is no water?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lo siento, le traeré agua embotellada.
dialogue.meaning: I’m sorry, I will bring you bottled water.

scenario.brief: You are checking on the status of your room change and asking about a taxi.
scenario.goal: You should successfully follow up on your requests.

review.title: Review of Chapter 7: At the hotel

dialogue.speaker: B
